data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘asama’ which means 'to rise'. Basooma is a beautiful, evocative name for a girl, meaning 'fruitful' or 'fertile'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that a child born with this name will grow up to be a nurturer and a provider. The name Basooma carries the meaning “Fruitful, fertile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basooma usually hope their child will grow to embody fruitful, fertile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
